coldBaseline.recurrentMiss: diagnosis expected UNKNOWN, observed DEFERRED in 4/4 held-out cases

lesson.protectedLesson: Do not promote a stale dependent projection from UNKNOWN to DEFERRED until the refresh/invalidation mechanism and its current timing/run state are actually established. Diagnose DEFERRED only when a valid refresh path is proven and current evidence shows it is legitimately pending. Diagnose BROKEN only when sufficient evidence proves the required propagation route is absent or an established route executed and failed.
notTheLesson: one unsuccessful writer search proves no refresh route exists
safe no-patch behavior is sufficient for correct epistemic classification
